p1_issue: PR1209 preregister accepted caller-provided authority and matching digest, no authenticated outside caller
resolution: New production dispatch requires fixed external trust anchor and independently signed exact request before old policy guard, persistent access reservation, read and callback dispatch
trust_anchor_requirements: root-owned immutable file and ancestry, not group/world writable, no symlink
runtime effective UID nonroot, equals external validator_uid, excluded developer_uids
external signer Ed25519 public key provisioned outside repo/caller; active principal must exactly match
unexpired trust state and approval; explicit key/approval revocation checks
fixed immutable campaign snapshot exact inherited budget hash; private durable same-campaign reservation journal retained by separate host administration
reservation_behavior: exclusive create+fsync file+directory before sealed read; fixed campaign key independent of approval/path names; unknown/cancel/failure consumes and cannot retry
dependencies: system openssl pkeyutl Ed25519, no network or pip
limitations: Runtime trust anchor genuinely absent, not replaced with fixture keys
Host administrator and deployed signed code remain trusted; this Python boundary does not sandbox host root
Private persistent journal must be retained and not administratively reset; module never resets it
Native producer caller integration and CI are root/S2 responsibility; no actual independent approval or formal execution occurred
